aboutPage.label: Who We Are
aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.p1: Art Dekor Furniture is focused on bespoke interior production with premium finishes, careful proportions, and practical comfort.
aboutPage.p2: We are based in Lipjan and work with homeowners, architects, and businesses that value design clarity and high build quality.
aboutPage.p3: Each project is custom planned to fit your space, your daily rhythm, and your visual style.
aboutPage.statsProductsValue: Kitchens · Wardrobes · Bedrooms · Living Rooms · Sofas · Tables
aboutPage.value1Desc: Every piece is measured and produced for your exact layout and use case.
aboutPage.value2Desc: We select durable materials and elegant finishes with long-term performance in mind.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Our team blends technical skill with design sensitivity across every detail.
aboutPage.ctaText: Let us discuss your project and prepare a custom proposal.
